correctness.rationale: The exact package defines s^r independent uniform edge colors and missing colors as acyclic monochromatic subgraphs. One-hot vectors are negatively associated; disjoint color-coordinate blocks and common monotone-decreasing maps preserve negative association. Product MGF bounds give the stated Chernoff estimate. Conditioning on s independent self-loop colors gives E[M|L]=(q/a_s)Z_s, where Z_s is classical empty-box occupancy; total variance then yields the exact lower inequality and its asymptotic (e-2)c_*^2 with a_s->e^-1 and V_s/s->e^-1-2e^-2. The r=2 mean s q~c_*s^(2/3) is cited to Gravner–Kulhanek, not re-proved. Summable Chernoff tails via Borel-Cantelli establish the strong law for any coupling, and upper variance gives L2. Independently enumerated all 16 colorings for s=2 and 19683 for s=3, obtaining exact variance/lower bounds 15/64 vs 9/64, and 14396210/43046721 vs 6396416/43046721. The finite tests cannot establish all s,r.
